name: Fallen Sky Lake
summary: Fallen Sky Lake is a secluded body of water nestled deep within the forests of eastern Ashenvale. Situated between Silverwing Outpost and the encroaching Warsong Labor Camp, the serene waters hide danger in the form of hostile shadethicket bog beasts that aggressively defend the lake and its central isle.

sections.title: A Contested Sanctuary
sections.body: Tucked south of Silverwing Outpost and just west of the Warsong Labor Camp, Fallen Sky Lake offers a fleeting glimpse of Ashenvale's natural splendor before the Orcish axes took root nearby. The shores and the small islet rising from the middle of the lake are inhabited by shadethickets—hulking bog beasts that view any intruder as a threat. The heart of the island serves as the domain of a powerful Shadethicket Oracle, who hoards the fallen moonstones once gathered at the lake and keeps the local shadethickets bound to the waters and relentlessly vigilant against travelers passing through.

faq.q: Where is Fallen Sky Lake located?
aliases: how to find fallen sky lake
faq.answer: Fallen Sky Lake is located in eastern Ashenvale, directly south of Silverwing Outpost, west of the Warsong Labor Camp, and northeast of Silverwing Grove.

faq.q: What creatures live around Fallen Sky Lake?
aliases: what is at fallen sky lake
faq.answer: The lake and its surrounding banks are overrun by shadethickets—aggressive bog beasts—led by a formidable Shadethicket Oracle who dwells on the central island.

faq.q: Why is the Shadethicket Oracle important?
faq.answer: The Shadethicket Oracle is the leader of the shadethickets gathered at the lake. He hoards the fallen moonstones that night elves once gathered there, so those who need a moonstone must slay him on his central isle.

angles.text: Night elves once gathered moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake, but the hostile shadethicket bog beasts that now claim its waters have made even this quiet corner of the forest a place of danger.
Positioned just south of Silverwing Outpost, the lake represents yet another corner of the sacred ancestral forest where wild beasts have grown erratic amidst the gathering drums of the Horde.
